name: Strength and Mercy
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lays heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the winds many creatures have begun to lose themselves, and with Ur'endra's great might she poses a dire threat to the delicate balance. She roams the Shen'dar Highlands to the northwest of here.

Show me you have the fortitude to end her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
narrative.objectives: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.You have done well, champion. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.
narrative.requestItemsText: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.
